g.text: BIR: existing streaming backbone, retained without architectural change
Multi-scale shared computation and bounded temporal memory; no SDU or VoW information flows into the frozen prior backbone.
The tensor has 2 count channels + 5 temporal bins x 2 polarities. Report-change savings and dense GPU runtime are distinct metrics.
